07:00 off (since 06:00 UTC)   09:55:15 on   11:04:04 off   12:04:34 on   (still on at 12:13)

Observations:
- 0x601 repeats the block about every 7 min (09:59/10:00, 10:06/10:07, ... ), also without registration.
  Some blocks are incomplete (11:09, 11:10, 12:04, 12:08): frames missing, not filtered by the firmware
  (the 12:08 gap appears in the recordings of the old and the new firmware alike).
- 0x0052 = 0 (09:54, compressor off) -> 256 = 0x0100 from 09:55 (compressor on 09:55:15) -> 0 at 11:04
  (compressor off 11:04:04) -> 256 at 12:04 (compressor on 12:04:34) and 12:06, 12:13.
  Four transitions, all matching: 0x0052 follows the compressor / heating demand of HK1.
- Constant on all blocks: 0x0010 = 2, 0x000F = 65136 (0xFE70, -40.0), 0x0004 = 65136, 0x0056 = 0,
  0x0057 = 0, 0x0028 = 300 (30.0), 0x005A = 512 (0x0200).
- 0x0052 is also sent on its own at the moment it changes (09:55, 11:04, 12:04 lines with only 0x0052), i.e.
  0x601 pushes it event-driven, within ~30 s of the compressor change.
